name: Acheron’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, at the start of the Fight phase every enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model must take a Battle-shock test with a -1 penalty.

name: Aggressive Assault
summary: Each time this model makes a ranged attack against the closest eligible target, add 1 to the Hit roll.

name: Atrapos’ Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model can re-roll both the Hit roll and the Wound roll when attacking a Titanic or Towering model.

name: Castigator’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model's ranged weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability and their Armour Penetration improves by 1.

name: Chainbreaker
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, remove the Battle-shocked condition from one friendly Imperium unit within 12" of this model.

name: Crusader’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model adds 1 to the Hit roll for each of its ranged attacks.

name: Defender’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of each attack allocated to this model.

name: Errant’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model can re-roll Advance rolls and its ranged weapons gain the Assault ability.

name: Exemplar of the Code
summary: At the start of the battle, choose an enemy unit as this model's quarry; re-roll Wound rolls against it, and pick a new quarry whenever the current one is destroyed.

name: Gallant’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model can re-roll Charge rolls and re-roll Hit rolls for its melee attacks.

name: Impetuous Glory
summary: After this model makes a Charge move, until end of turn add 1 Attack to its reaper chain-cleaver strike profile and 2 Attacks to its sweep profile.

name: Ion Aegis (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Armiger model is within 6" of this model, ranged attacks against that Armiger treat it as having Benefit of Cover.

name: Lancer’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Legendary Freeblade
summary: Once per turn, when you target this model with a Stratagem, you can reduce that Stratagem's Command Point cost by 1.

name: Magaera’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, ranged attacks this model makes against the closest eligible target get +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Martial Pride
summary: When this unit Consolidates, models can move up to 3" further, provided the unit ends the move within Engagement Range of an enemy unit.

name: Mentor (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, models with this ability re-roll Wound rolls when attacking this model's quarry.

name: Paladin’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model's weapons gain the Lethal Hits ability, and its melee weapons also gain the Lance ability.

name: Punishing Salvoes
summary: If this model Remains Stationary in the Movement phase, its ranged weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability until end of turn.

name: Ram Jets
summary: Each time this model makes a Normal or Advance move, add D3" to its Move characteristic for that move.

name: Saturation Fire
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against a unit within range of an objective marker gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Seasoned Noble
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against the closest eligible target get +1 to their Armour Penetration.

name: Selfless Protector
summary: If this model blocks visibility to a friendly Imperial Knights model targeted by a ranged attack, that model gains Benefit of Cover and a 4+ invulnerable save against the attack.

name: Styrix’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, after this model shoots or fights, pick an enemy unit it hit; that unit must take a Battle-shock test with a -1 penalty.

name: Suppression Protocols
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit (not a Monster or Vehicle) hit by its Armiger autocannon attacks; until your next turn that unit subtracts 1 from Hit rolls it makes.

name: Thin Their Ranks
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against enemy units, excluding Monsters and Vehicles, gain the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Thundercharge
summary: If equipped with both a thundershock spear and a bellatus reaper chainsword, this model's melee weapons get +2 Attacks.

name: Thundershock
summary: When this model targets with its thundercoil harpoon, roll a D6 for the target and each enemy unit within 6" of it; on a 4+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds after this model's attacks resolve.

name: Warden’s Duty (Bondsman)
summary: While bonded, this model's weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability, and its ranged weapons also gain Ignores Cover.

name: Code Chivalric
summary: At the start of the battle, select or randomly roll one Deed and one Quality (your Oath). Your Quality's effect applies all battle; completing your Deed makes your army Honoured and gains 2CP (3CP if either was rolled randomly).
